steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Film is a major global media form that combines visual, audio, and narrative codes to tell stories and create experiences for cinema and home audiences.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Film genres include: action, horror, comedy, sci-fi, romance, thriller, documentary, animation. Genres set audience expectations and help with marketing and distribution.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Genre hybrids blend elements from multiple genres — e.g. romantic comedy, sci-fi horror. Postmodern films may deliberately mix or parody genre conventions.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Richard Dyer's star theory: film stars are constructed images, not real people. Stars function as cultural symbols — e.g. Dwayne Johnson represents strength and reliability.
